data.name: RepAir
data.description: Founded in 2020, RepAir Carbon develops an ultra-efficient electrochemical system that captures CO₂ from diluted sources including direct air capture and industrial emissions, without requiring heat, liquids, or solvents. In April 2025 the company secured $15 million in Series A extension funding co-led by Taranis Carbon Ventures and Extantia Capital, with participation from Ormat Technologies and Repsol, plus a $3M non-dilutive grant from the Israeli Innovation Authority. RepAir has operations in the US, Israel and Luxembourg, and has been selected for the Pelican DAC project in Louisiana with Shell and Mitsubishi as well as Europe's first onshore DAC-CCS project in France with C-Questra.
